title: I this a realistic solution to the game sounding ai written
author: Middle-Moist
selftext:
So I started my dream game. Working on controls but I always get ahead of myself and decided to try something. I had Claude train itself on stylometry and my notes from the past 20 years, and write a screenplay for a 75 hour main game and 25-40 hours of side quests narrated in the style of Olaf Stapledon. It came back as close or closer to than known samples of his own writings. I checked it myself and gt the same results and it is being checked by a data scientist when they have time. I'd like to make sure it's accurate because then I had it use that same stylometric analysis across the screenplay. Every single unique npc is written to sound symmetricly like a different open source author whose writing style is checked against the npcs personality. As well as designing a stylometry code block that will keep random lines generated by background characters sounding human. Then I had it turn it into a book series for me to read. And...its pretty good so far.

  
is this a waste of time from someone jumping into this after realizing the block that stopped me from creating this game for decades is less and less apparent? Is there a better way this novice just doesn't know of?

  
let it be known i will display at all times that the game wa created using claude i just didnt want it to sound like it was from the dialogue
